# Acacia Pet Clinic

> > Acacia Pet Clinic provides comprehensive veterinary care in San Jose, CA, serving the Cambrian Park, Willow Glen, and South Bay communities with wellness exams, vaccinations, surgery, and preventive care services.

Acacia Pet Clinic (also known as Acacia Pet Hospital and Acacia Animal Hospital) offers bilingual veterinary services including DHPP, Bordetella, and Leptospirosis vaccinations, with specialized care for small breeds like Shih Tzus, Pekingese, and Lhasa Apsos. The clinic emphasizes preventive care, transparent pricing, and personalized treatment plans for dogs and cats throughout the San Jose area.

## Key Topics

- Pet Wellness & Preventive Care
- Pet Vaccinations (DHPP, Bordetella, Leptospirosis)
